llm_response.reason: The website shows several scam indicators: (1) Contact page is inaccessible, preventing legitimate business inquiry; (2) Privacy policy uses generic language and lacks any specific owner or data management information; (3) SSL certificate issues noted, which compromises security; (4) The domain was registered extremely recently (May 2025), and not by a French company but by a registrant in China; (5) Registrar and ownership details are hidden or absent; (6) Mismatch between claimed French luxury branding and Asian domain origin. These characteristics align with how fake online shopping scams operate, attempting to mimic legitimate e-commerce while concealing true ownership and avoiding accountability.
